paper.title_en: The role of strangeness and baryon enhancement in heavy-quark hadronisation from pp to Pb$-$Pb collisions with ALICE
paper.abstract_en: In this contribution, a combined study of charm-meson and charm-baryon production with ALICE is presented. The $Λ_{\mathrm{c}}^{+}/\mathrm{D^{0}}$ ratio in pp collisions at $\sqrt{s} = 13.6$ TeV and the first measurement of the nuclear modification factor of $Ξ_{\mathrm{c}}^{0}$ baryons in Pb$-$Pb collisions at $\sqrt{s_\mathrm{NN}} = 5.02$ TeV are reported. Furthermore, measurements of the $\mathrm{D_s^+/D^+}$ production ratio from low-multiplicity pp collisions at $\sqrt{s} = 13.6$ TeV to Pb$-$Pb collisions at $\sqrt{s_\mathrm{NN}} = 5.36$ TeV are presented. Lastly, the first measurement of the $p_\mathrm{T}$-differential $\mathrm{D_{s1}(2536)^+/D_s^+}$ yield ratio is shown.
